<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_BudgetPlanning" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/budget-planning">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BudgetPlanning" name="Department Budget Planning" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BudgetPlanning" name="Budget planning begins"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OutlineObjectives" name="Outline objectives for the upcoming period"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftPlan" name="Draft plan with cost estimates and justifications"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StrategicReview" name="Review plan in strategic alignment meeting"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StrategicFeedback" name="Adjustments required after strategic review?" default="Flow_StrategicToFinance"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinanceReview" name="Assess budget feasibility"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FinanceFeedback" name="Adjustments required after finance review?" default="Flow_FinanceToFinalApproval"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeAdjustments" name="Adjust plan"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DocumentAdjustments" name="Document adjustments"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveAdjustments" name="Obtain stakeholder approval for adjustments"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinalApproval" name="Approve final budget version"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateBudget" name="Allocate budget to department"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DistributeBudget" name="Distribute budget"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BeginImplementation" name="Begin implementing plan"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_BudgetDistributed" name="Budget distributed and implementation begun"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToOutline" sourceRef="StartEvent_BudgetPlanning" targetRef="Task_OutlineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OutlineToDraft" sourceRef="Task_OutlineObjectives" targetRef="Task_DraftPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DraftToStrategicReview" sourceRef="Task_DraftPlan" targetRef="Task_StrategicReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StrategicReviewToGateway" sourceRef="Task_StrategicReview" targetRef="Gateway_StrategicFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StrategicToAdjustments" sourceRef="Gateway_StrategicFeedback" targetRef="Task_MakeAdjustments">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Feedback indicates adjustments are required</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StrategicToFinance" sourceRef="Gateway_StrategicFeedback" targetRef="Task_FinanceReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinanceReviewToGateway" sourceRef="Task_FinanceReview" targetRef="Gateway_FinanceFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinanceToAdjustments" sourceRef="Gateway_FinanceFeedback" targetRef="Task_MakeAdjustments">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Feedback indicates adjustments are required</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinanceToFinalApproval" sourceRef="Gateway_FinanceFeedback" targetRef="Task_FinalApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdjustmentsToDocumentation" sourceRef="Task_MakeAdjustments" targetRef="Task_DocumentAdjustments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentationToApproval" sourceRef="Task_DocumentAdjustments" targetRef="Task_ApproveAdjustments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApprovalToStrategicReview" sourceRef="Task_ApproveAdjustments" targetRef="Task_StrategicReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalApprovalToAllocation" sourceRef="Task_FinalApproval" targetRef="Task_AllocateBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllocationToDistribution" sourceRef="Task_AllocateBudget" targetRef="Task_DistributeBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DistributionToImplementation" sourceRef="Task_DistributeBudget" targetRef="Task_BeginImplementation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ImplementationToEnd" sourceRef="Task_BeginImplementation" targetRef="EndEvent_BudgetDistributed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
